description: This file defines the OptionSelector class used for managing selection of columns or adhoc columns in a dataset, including methods for adding, removing, replacing, swapping, and checking values, with support for multiple selections.

classes.name: OptionSelector
classes.description: A class for managing a list of column options, supporting multi-select and individual operations.

methods.name: getColumnNameOrAdhocColumn
methods.description: Retrieves the column name or adhoc column label from a ColumnMeta or AdhocColumn object.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new column or adhoc column to the selection.

methods.name: del
methods.description: Removes a column at a specified index from the selection.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces a column at a specified index with a new value.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the positions of two columns in the selection.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a column or adhoc column is present in the selection.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns the current list of selected columns or the first selected column if not multi-select.
